subject.title: Feature: Tool-level sandbox mode for selective isolation

question: Which security contract should own host-versus-sandbox execution for individual tools in a mixed session?
rationale: Current code intentionally separates session sandboxing, tool allow/deny filtering, and exec-only elevated routing; selecting a per-tool placement schema changes the core security boundary and config surface.

options.title: Design placement contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a documented placement model, schema, migration expectations, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep session-scoped sandboxing
options.body: Reject selective placement and require tools to inherit session sandboxing except for explicit owner-approved gateway escape declarations.

options.title: Fold into broader sandbox roadmap
options.body: Track the need under the broader sandbox architecture work instead of adding a standalone selective mode now.

recommendation.title: Design placement contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define a documented placement model, schema, migration expectations, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the issue as still-open maintainer follow-up and has recent history across the affected sandbox/tool-policy surfaces.
